jobs.title: Associate Creative Director
jobs.description:
London, Hybrid

This position sits in our Marketing & Technology
service based in London. We combine data, technology, creative and paid media to crack brands’ business problems & drive revenue through a variety of digital marketing solutions like social, influencer, TTL ad campaigns, augmented reality, AI and innovation. Our clients include eBay, easyJet, Just Eat Takeaway and Pepsico.

Job Purpose

We are looking for an Associate Creative Director for an exciting AI client of ours. The work we produce for them is varied and can range drastically from simple BAU creative responses, to in-person creative sprints and even full productions across multiple global markets. So, broad creative experience is required to ensure that whatever the brief, you feel comfortable leading the team and providing clear direction.

As a creative lead on the client, you will be responsible for ensuring creative excellence across all campaigns and projects. You will work with a wider team of creatives, designers, producers etc, providing clear, decisive feedback, guidance and inspiration to support members of the team across these disciplines. As well as building, delegating and empowering the team to confidently take on work, you will be a hands-on creative with a a willingness to ‘get your hands dirty’ to help the team.

Communication & presentation skills are critical due to frequent touchpoints with internal and external senior stakeholders in, both of which are located across the UK and US. You’ll be expected to work fast and nimble, getting work organised and ready to present to client. You will also attend and lead in-person creative sprints & workshops with the wider creative teams as well as the clients internal creative teams.

Key Responsibilities

Craft brilliant, award winning ideas that capture attention and inspire our clients creatives
Create opportunities for account growth through selling brilliant creative campaigns that have community and culture at the heart of them
Strategic thinking to lead your roster of clients to success through excellent creative
Lead, develop, motivate and inspire DEPT’s creative teams and encourage collaboration
Work closely with the accounts team to ensure a smooth monthly production process
Suggest best ways of working, and hustle for the best opportunities
Deliver and inspire innovative and high quality work across all deliverables from the team
Be aware of and respond to current advertising and media trends and pop culture
Use experience and ideas to contribute to the development of our creative process
Present work internally and externally to an excellent standard
Stay up-to-date with industry developments
Initiate and facilitate creative team collaboration and sharing, and team cohesion through social and team building initiatives

Skills And Previous Experience

Be an AI-native and have an interest in AI generally
Strategically minded with the ability to sell bigger ideas
Must be Figma-native (this is where we do 90% of our work/presentations)
Keep up to date with the latest tech/AI trends and have a broad understanding of the competitor landscape.
Strong performance chops
Outstanding portfolio across multiple creative disciplines with examples of tech or AI-led campaigns
Ability to work fast and be decisive
ImageGen skills - using AI to generate high quality imagery (big bonus)
Ability to meet deadlines and collaborate well with the team and clients
High attention to visual and copywriting details
Ability to remain focused under pressure within a fast-paced environment
A love for learning new things and exploring new mediums

WE OFFER

A flexible, hybrid working policy
The choice of medical healthcare providers (Bupa or Medicash)
25 days holiday plus bank holidays and your birthday off each year
Company pension scheme
EAP scheme
Ride to work scheme
Enhanced family friendly policies
Buddy Program: You will be paired with a ‘Buddy’ to help you through your first weeks’ at DEPT®.
A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021 and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.
Awesome clients. Whether big or small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with clients of all sizes and across all industries. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.
Global annual DEPT® Cares Month in which employees come together and donate their skills to support local charities.

WHO ARE WE?

We are pioneers at heart. What does that mean? We are always looking forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. We were born digital and we are a new model of agency, with a deep skillset in tech and marketing. That’s why we hire curious, self-driven, talented people who never stop innovating.

Our culture is big enough to cope and small enough to care. Meaning, that with people across 30+ countries, we’re big enough to provide you with the best tools, global opportunities, and benefits that help you thrive. While acting small by investing in you, your growth, your team, and giving you the autonomy to solve our clients problems, no matter where you are in the world.

DEPT® is committed to making a positive impact on the planet and since 2021 has been Climate Neutral and B Corporation certified.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

jobs.title: Brand & Product Development Lead (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Du liebst starke Consumer Brands, hast ein außergewöhnliches Gespür für Produkte und Design und gleichzeitig Freude daran, Dinge wirklich umzusetzen?

Dann könnte das hier ziemlich gut passen.

Mit unseren Marken ouchie und 12minutes, haben wir den verstaubten Erste Hilfe Markt in den letzten Monaten und Jahren stark aufgemischt. Das virale Erste Hilfe Set wird von tausenden Familien täglich genutzt und mit dem innovationen Erste Hilfe Kurs für Eltern konnten wir schon zahlreiche Leben retten!

Jetzt möchten wir den nächsten Schritt gehen und sowohl unsere Marken als auch unser Produktportfolio im Familien- und Gesundheitsbereich weiterentwickeln.

Dafür suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende, ambitionierte Person, die gemeinsam mit uns die nächsten Produkte entwickelt, die Marke verantwortet und gleichzeitig die operativen Strukturen dahinter aufbaut.

Aufgaben

Verantwortung für das Produktportfolio und die Marken ouchie und 12minutes

Entwicklung von Produktideen und Kategorien, die nicht nur funktional überzeugen, sondern sich auch stark kommunizieren und vermarkten lassen

Weiterentwicklung bestehender Produkte, Sets, Designs und Verpackungen

Übersetzung von Ideen in konkrete Produktkonzepte und Briefings

Identifikation und Auswahl geeigneter Hersteller und Lieferanten

Koordination von Design, Sampling, Produktentwicklung und Produktion

Unterstützung beim internationalen Rollout unserer Produkte

Koordination von Produktlaunches mit dem Marketing, damit Produkt, Story, Content und Kampagne von Anfang an zusammenspielen

Operative Verantwortung für den Customer Service (1MA), um Kundenfeedback, Trends und Learnings direkt in bestehende und neue Produkte einfließen zu lassen

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern bei Produktstrategie, Sortiment, Marke und Wachstum

Qualifikation
Uns ist weniger wichtig, dass dein Lebenslauf exakt einem bestimmten Muster entspricht. Viel wichtiger ist für uns die Kombination aus Gespür für Marken und Design, Unternehmergeist und operativer Stärke.

Du passt besonders gut zu uns, wenn du:

ein sehr gutes Gespür für Marken, Produkte, Packaging und Design hast

Consumer Brands liebst und neue Marken, Produkte und Trends früh entdeckst

verstehst, dass ein starkes Consumer Product nicht nur gut funktionieren, sondern auch eine gute Story erzählen und begehrlich sein muss

bei einem neuen Produkt sofort darüber nachdenkst, wie man es noch schöner, einfacher oder besser machen könnte

gleichzeitig strukturiert, analytisch und extrem zuverlässig arbeitest

gerne Verantwortung übernimmst und Themen selbstständig vorantreibst

keine Scheu davor hast, mit Herstellern zu verhandeln, Samples zu organisieren oder Lieferprobleme zu lösen

schnell zwischen kreativem Produktdenken und operativer Umsetzung wechseln kannst

gerne in einem kleinen, unternehmerischen Umfeld arbeitest und was aufbauen möchtest

sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch sprichst

Erfahrung in Consumer Products, Beauty, Lifestyle, FMCG, D2C, Retail, Product Development, Sourcing oder Operations ist ein Plus.

Benefits
Wir suchen eine Unternehmerin im Unternehmen. Jemanden, der selbst tief in den Themen steckt, Produkte entwickelt, mit Marketing Ideen weiterdenkt, Hersteller findet und Dinge von Anfang bis Ende umsetzt.

Gleichzeitig bekommst du sehr viel Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum. Wenn ouchie weiter wächst, besteht sehr viel Potential für dich mit zu wachsen.

Warum wir?

Weil du hier nicht Produkt Nummer 814 in einem großen Unternehmen betreust.

Du kannst mit uns entscheiden:

Welche Produkte bauen wir als Nächstes?

Wie sollen sie aussehen?

Welche Story erzählen wir rund um sie?

Wie bringen wir Produkt und Marketing so zusammen, dass Menschen sie wirklich haben wollen?

Mit welchen Herstellern arbeiten wir?

Und wie bringen wir ouchie von Deutschland in weitere Märkte?

Wenn du Lust hast, eine Consumer Brand nicht nur zu verwalten, sondern wirklich mit aufzubauen, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

Für die Bewerbung

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf oder dein LinkedIn-Profil und beantworte uns kurz drei Fragen:

Welche drei Consumer Brands findest du aktuell besonders stark und warum?

Welches Produkt würdest du für ouchie als Nächstes entwickeln?

Auf welches Produkt oder Projekt, das du bisher umgesetzt hast, bist du besonders stolz?

Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

You'll build and manage a team that brings together creative production talent and creator management expertise. You'll be a player-coach: raise the bar, hire strong talent, and still get in the work yourself. At Whatnot, everyone is an IC.

You Will

Own the EU performance creative engine across paid social: you're accountable for the volume and quality of creative Europe ships every month.
Balance performance and brand: push for creative that drives results without letting it drift from what makes Whatnot recognizable and trustworthy.
Build the strategy and operating system to scale creative output while reducing guesswork, improving quality, and increasing creative impact.

Connect differently shaped projects and strategies in ways that they all lead to effective outcomes.

About Stratio

Stratio keeps public transport running. We monitor fleet health in real time and tell the world's largest operators exactly what's going to fail before it does.

Our go-to-market runs on industry events. You own them end to end, and the content, the website and the automation around them.

This is a hands-on, one-person marketing function. No team to manage. You’ll brief a stand builder, a film crew, a designer or a PR freelancer when the work calls for them, and do everything else yourself. You do the work. You own the output. You use every tool available - especially LLMs and automation - to do the work of an entire department.

You’ll report directly to leadership and work closely with sales and product.

If you've ever been the only marketing person at a company and thrived, this is for you.

What your weeks look like

Events and speaking

Events are a major focus of this role. You run the event calendar: the shows where we exhibit, the conferences where we speak, and our own customer roundtables, on-site events at client sites and client advisory board.

For each stand: the booking, the design, the build contract, logistics, staffing, the run of show and the debrief.

For each talk: the abstract, the co-speaker, the deadline, the deck, the rehearsal.

After every event you report meetings held against meetings booked, deals generated and deals impacted, and you follow up with the leads generated in cooperation with our sales team to ensure event leads become opportunities in our pipeline.

Content creation

You write and publish case studies, blog posts, landing pages, LinkedIn posts, one-pagers, and sales enablement materials.

You produce our benchmark report with engineering, the abstracts and decks for our speakers, and the trade-press pushes around them.

You take raw inputs - a customer success metric, a product update, a conversation with a customer - and turn them into compelling stories.

You use LLMs daily to draft, iterate, and repurpose content across formats and channels.

You move fast without sacrificing quality.

Website ownership

You manage and update the website. New pages, copy changes, landing pages for campaigns, event pages and meeting-booking pages. You’re comfortable in a CMS. You don’t file a ticket to change a headline, you just do it.

You optimize for both traditional SEO and LLM discoverability, making sure that when someone asks “what’s the best predictive maintenance product,” Stratio shows up in the answer.

Campaigns and demand generation

You plan and execute campaigns to build our pipeline. They’re designed around the event calendar: the outreach that fills the meeting schedule before each show and the follow-up after it, webinars between events, LinkedIn content, paid only to named accounts, co-marketing with partners.

You draw up the account list for each event with sales, run the outreach and fill the calendar.

You set up tracking, measure what works, and kill what doesn’t. You think in terms of pipeline contribution.

Sales enablement

You build the materials that help the sales team close. Pitch decks, case studies, proposal templates.

You sit close to sales conversations and notice when the same objection keeps coming up, then you build something to handle it.

Analytics and reporting

You set up and maintain marketing analytics.

Per event: meetings held against booked, deals generated, deals impacted, what the field taught us and what we change because of it.

Website traffic, content performance, email metrics.

In the end how much pipeline we’ve generated, from which channels. You also can explain in simple terms what’s working, what’s not, and why. You don’t need a BI team to pull numbers.

Automation and tooling

You build workflows that save time. Email sequences, content distribution, lead scoring, social scheduling, speaker deadlines, meeting booking, post-event follow-up.

You use LLMs, no-code tools / light scripting to automate repetitive work.

You’re always looking for the next thing that should be a workflow instead of manual effort.

What we’re looking for

Must Have:

3 to 7 years in B2B marketing, ideally with some exposure to technical or industrial products
You’ve run B2B trade show or conference presence end to end at least twice: negotiated the space, briefed the stand builder, pre-booked the meetings, ran the floor, did the follow-up and reported the result
You’ve secured speaking slots through calls for papers or curated programmes, ideally with a customer on stage

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Founding Creative Director based in Germany.

As Founding Creative Director, you will define the creative standard for a fast-moving company entering a period of significant product and brand growth. You will own creative direction across launches, positioning, storytelling, design systems, and every major customer-facing artifact. This is a hands-on leadership role where you will personally ship work while establishing the creative bar for the organization. You will work closely with the founding team in a highly autonomous, distributed, and low-bureaucracy environment. Over time, you will build a small internal creative team spanning design, motion, and content. The pace is intense, the feedback loop is short, and your decisions will have a direct impact on what reaches the market. This is an opportunity for a highly opinionated creative leader who wants to set the standard rather than inherit one.

Accountabilities

Own the creative vision and direction across the brand, ensuring consistency and excellence across every customer-facing touchpoint.
Define narrative, positioning, and creative strategy for product launches, treating design as a strategic business tool rather than decoration.
Personally create and ship high-impact work during the first year, including landing pages, launch videos, presentations, social content, and other go-to-market assets.
Own and evolve the design system, establishing a scalable creative foundation for future products and campaigns.
Act as the ultimate creative quality bar, creating or approving anything that is released under the brand.
Partner directly with the founding team to turn complex products and ideas into compelling stories, experiences, and market-facing narratives.
Build and eventually lead a lean internal creative function of approximately two to three people across design, motion, and content.
Establish processes that allow the creative team to brief, position, produce, and launch work independently without relying heavily on external agencies.
Maintain a high standard of execution while managing multiple launches and priorities in a rapidly changing environment.
Champion the effective use of AI throughout the creative workflow, identifying new tools and workflows that improve speed, experimentation, and quality.

Requirements

Demonstrated experience owning creative direction, whether in-house or within an agency, with evidence of making final creative decisions rather than simply executing against direction.
Exceptional creative taste and the ability to articulate, defend, and apply a clear point of view about what makes work distinctive and effective.
Strong narrative and strategic thinking, with the ability to connect design, positioning, storytelling, and business objectives.
A portfolio demonstrating high-quality creative work across relevant formats such as digital experiences, branding, campaigns, launch materials, editorial, motion, or consumer-facing products.
The versatility to operate across different creative disciplines and industries; experience in SaaS is not required, while backgrounds in fashion, art, editorial, consumer brands, or similarly design-led environments are welcome.
A proven ability to deliver excellent work in high-speed, ambiguous environments, with multiple priorities and rapidly evolving feedback.
Hands-on experience with AI as part of the creative or product-development workflow. You should be comfortable experimenting with AI tools and have already used AI to build, prototype, design, or create something tangible.
Strong interest in becoming increasingly technical and capable of independently shipping a landing page or similar digital experience within your first year.
A proactive, low-ego approach with strong ownership, direct communication, sound judgment, and a willingness to act without waiting for permission.
Comfort working asynchronously within a globally distributed team and communicating clearly through writing.
High standards combined with the ability to move quickly, adapt to changing priorities, and maintain quality under pressure.
A genuine interest in emerging AI capabilities and a willingness to continuously experiment, learn, and share effective workflows with others.

Benefits

Competitive salary plus equity or stock grants, giving you the opportunity to own a meaningful part of what you help build.
High degree of autonomy and ownership, with responsibility for solving problems rather than simply completing assigned tasks.
Direct exposure to the founding team and the opportunity to have your creative decisions reach the market without layers of internal approval.
Fully distributed, global, and async-first working environment with low bureaucracy and a strong emphasis on written communication.
The opportunity to define the creative standard and build a new internal creative function from the ground up.
Work that reaches real consumer brands and has visible impact on a rapidly evolving category.
Learning budget to support continued professional and creative development.
Access to premium AI tools, including ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, and Lovable.
Quarterly budget for experimenting with new AI and creative tools.
A culture that encourages knowledge sharing through demos, discussions, and collaboration around emerging AI workflows.
An environment built around trust, direct feedback, high standards, and meaningful ownership.
The opportunity to work at the intersection of creativity, technology, AI, and the future of customer experience.

jobs.description:
About the role

The Creative Lead
at Alea will shape and lead the company’s creative vision, ensuring a consistent and impactful brand expression across all channels, projects, and teams.
Reporting directly to the Head of Marketing, this hands-on leadership role combines brand strategy, creative production, and team management. The ideal candidate will be equally comfortable developing creative concepts, presenting ideas to stakeholders, and actively supporting the team in bringing them to life.

Key Responsibilities

Shape and lead Alea’s creative vision in alignment with the company’s brand and business objectives.
Lead and develop the design team by setting clear priorities, objectives, and KPIs.
Own and evolve Alea’s brand identity, guidelines, and creative standards.
Translate Alea’s mission, vision, and values into a strong and consistent brand experience.
Lead the creative development of marketing campaigns across digital and offline channels.
Lead exhibition booth design and production in collaboration with the Event Manager.
Lead video and photography projects, including briefing and coordinating external production partners.
Oversee thumbnail creation workflows across a portfolio of more than 23,000 games, ensuring quality, consistency, and timely delivery.
Act as the main creative point of contact across departments.
Manage relationships with creative agencies, freelancers, suppliers, and production partners.
Contribute directly to creative execution when projects require hands-on support.

Skills & Experience Required

Proven experience in a senior creative or creative leadership role.
Experience leading and developing a design or creative team.
Strong knowledge of brand strategy and visual identity development.
Ability to translate a company’s mission, vision, and values into a cohesive brand identity.
Experience leading creative projects from initial concept to final delivery.
Strong understanding of marketing campaigns, creative performance, and data-informed decision-making.
Experience leading exhibition or trade show projects, including production and on-site execution.
Experience leading photography and video productions and coordinating external partners.
Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite; experience with 3D design tools is highly valued.
Excellent communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and organisational skills.
A proactive, collaborative, and hands-on approach that balances strategic thinking with execution.

What We Offer

A competitive salary package based on your experience.
An impressive benefits package, focused on our culture of integral health that includes medical insurance, gym with personal trainer, sauna and hyperbaric chamber, and fresh fruit every day.
Tax-advantageous wage benefit: Meal card, transport package and other measures such as childcare allowance.
Discount on Veg it (vegan meals) to order your lunch at the office.
Flexible start and finish times.
Reduced working hours in August.
23 holidays plus 3 extra days at disposal
Hybrid Work Model.
English classes
Parking benefit for those who live outside of Barcelona.
And what we are very proud of, you will join a young, motivated and powerful team with a great team culture. As it’s not all work, we maintain the team spirit with team building events, parties and workshops where you can enjoy our achievements. When you leave in the afternoon, you can join our paddle tennis games near the office.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Nuestra cultura y nuestras personas son el motor de WPP Media, y nos impulsan a ofrecer experiencias excepcionales. En este rol, tu contribución será clave para vivir y promover nuestros valores:

Ser Extraordinario: Liderando colectivamente para inspirar una creatividad transformadora.
Ser Abierto: Equilibrando las experiencias de las personas y los clientes, cultivando la confianza.
Ser Optimista: Impulsando el crecimiento y el desarrollo para movilizar a toda la empresa.

Tu rol y contribución

Actualmente, desde nuestro equipo de Relevance
buscamos un/a Creative Director
que impulse la diferenciación de nuestra agencia en el mercado, la retención de clientes y la generación de negocio a través de un liderazgo creativo excepcional.

Desarrollar e implementar estrategias creativas alineadas con los objetivos de negocio del cliente y el enfoque distintivo de nuestra agencia.
Elevar la calidad de las propuestas creativas en todas las cuentas, asegurando que nuestro trabajo supere los estándares de la industria.
Liderar, mentorizar e inspirar a un equipo creativo multidisciplinar en áreas como Motion, Producción y Brand Experience.
Establecer y optimizar procesos y flujos de trabajo creativos para maximizar la productividad y la excelencia.
Actuar como socio creativo para los clientes, construyendo relaciones de confianza y demostrando el valor de nuestras soluciones.

Sólida experiencia liderando y desarrollando equipos creativos multidisciplinares en un entorno de agencia.
Experiencia demostrable en el desarrollo e implementación de estrategias creativas que generen un impacto medible en el negocio.

Visión de negocio para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento y fortalecer la relación con los clientes.
Capacidad para establecer y optimizar procesos y flujos de trabajo creativos que garanticen la excelencia.
Formación superior en Publicidad, Diseño, Comunicación o campos relacionados.

En WPP Media, invertimos en nuestra gente, impulsando tu crecimiento profesional con la misma pasión con la que lideramos la inversión responsable en medios. Formar parte de nuestro equipo significa acceder a una red global de conocimiento y oportunidades, donde podrás expandir tus horizontes y estar siempre a la vanguardia del sector. Reporting to:
Chief Commercial Officer

Your mission at Whereby

To lead Marketing strategies and tactics to grow Whereby’s brand, increase awareness, generate demand among target audiences, and capture demand to increase Sales pipeline, revenue and new user acquisition.

What Whereby Is All About

Freedom to work from anywhere:
our mission with Whereby is to give people freedom to live and work where they thrive.

📍 Our global HQ is in Norway, but our users (and team) are worldwide - Whereby has been used in nearly every country in the world by millions of people. 🌏

By making it possible to collaborate as well over video as you can in real life, we want to give you the choice to work from where your life happens. To allow you to be in a place where you can think and focus, but also allow a seamless and instant connection with others when you need to.

To work at Whereby you’ll need to be an excellent communicator, able to work autonomously when needed but also collaborate remotely with our global team.

Benefits include unlimited holiday, flexible, fully remote working setup, home office budget, enhanced parental leave, equity and more.

Read more about working at Whereby here.

Marketing mission

Whereby is loved by millions of users globally, and Marketing plays a key role in making sure that we can increase awareness and gain new customers, adding true value to every stage of their experience with us. Focused on the Telehealth and Digital Mental Health industries, we’re on a mission to facilitate healthcare consultations globally through mid-sized to enterprise customers in the sector as well as individual practitioners and clinics.

The Marketing Lead’s mission is to increase sign ups and adoption of Whereby Embedded, our API product, as well as Whereby Meetings, our simple video call solution, with a strong focus on the healthcare sector.

Embedded is our core focus, with a sales led strategy focused on account based marketing, brand equity building and sales enablement, you will work closely with the wider Commercial team to attract, educate and close high-value customers.

For Meetings, the focus is on an experimental product led strategy, acquiring new paying users through various channels.

You will closely collaborate with other departments across the business on all areas of B2B Marketing, from content to product to advertising, and will have support from a performance marketing agency and freelance designer. You’ll find creative ways to reach, educate, inspire and engage our target audiences. As a small team, every day is different! You should be prepared to prioritise ruthlessly, collaborate with other departments and adapt to the changeable nature of a start-up.

🔍 What we're looking for in our Marketing Lead

This is a maternity cover contract. You will adopt the existing strategy laid out by the current Marketing Lead, but with flexibility that things can change quickly in a start-up! This is the only Marketing role in a small commercial team, so you need to be able to both think strategically, and be hands-on executing tactics and campaigns across multiple channels.

We’re looking for someone with previous B2B Marketing experience in a start-up environment. You are a generalist marketer, willing to get involved wherever needed. Supported by the Chief Commercial Officer, as well as a Performance Marketing agency and freelance designer, you will assist across a variety of campaigns and channels and have true business impact.

Your attributes

You may be just the right person if others have described you as an autonomous can-do marketer who embodies the below competencies...

Creative thinker
Customer focused
Organised
Analytics savvy
Excellent communicator
Adaptable
Good at prioritising

Your Previous Experience

We’re mostly looking for someone ready to get stuck in across all areas of Marketing to support the team and have quick impact, taking the reins when our current Marketing Lead heads off on maternity leave. With that said, you may be a good fit if you…

Are a current Marketing Lead/Senior Marketing Manager
Have proven hands-on experience in all or most of the following areas; Content/Social Media Marketing, Account Based Marketing, Brand building, SEO, Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Lifecycle Marketing, CRO/website management, Event Marketing
Have solid experience in B2B Marketing (Health tech or a technical/developer focused product a bonus!)
Experience working at a startup is desired
Experience working in a distributed team is beneficial

🌎 We believe in everyone

We fundamentally believe talent is distributed to all of us in equal measure. We open our doors (physical or URL) to everyone and we see our differences as a strength; it’s this philosophy that drives us towards our mission.

Cross-cultural communicator

This means we see your unique history as having value money cannot buy; we believe in the strength of every intersection of race, religion or belief, ethnic origin, different physical ability, family structure, socio-economics, age, nationality or citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity.

⚒️ The nuts and bolts of the role

🌟 How we'll measure your success

Influenced leads, sales pipeline & revenue (Embedded)
Paying user acquisition (Meetings)
Output and execution of Marketing campaigns/tactics

Strategic Responsibilities

Lead and execute the Marketing strategy
Propose campaigns and tactics to drive brand awareness, engagement, pipeline generation and acquisition with our ICP
Maintain strategic relationships and partner with key internal and external stakeholders including agencies and vendors
Measure and report on marketing performance, providing insight and assisting towards team and company goals
Budget responsibilities- Recommend budget allocations for Marketing activities and propose spend to the CCO. Accountable for marketing spend of always-on activity

Tactical Responsibilities

As the only Marketer in the company, you should expect to be involved across a variety of Marketing channels and functions. It is not expected that you will run activity across all channels at once, but throughout the year it is likely you will need to get involved across a variety of marketing channels.

Campaign and activity execution - across a variety of channels including those mentioned in the “previous experience” section
Reporting- Use various analytics tools to report on marketing effectiveness and impact across the company. Support the leadership team with board-level insights as required
